description: PostgreSQL 18 refcursor scalar and array storage, casts, catalogs, text/binary transport, and unsupported comparison/index boundaries
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_refcursor (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, cursor_name REFCURSOR, cursor_history REFCURSOR[]);
INSERT INTO type_matrix_refcursor VALUES (1, 'portal name', ARRAY['portal a', 'portal,b', '']::refcursor[]);
SELECT id, cursor_name, cursor_history, cursor_name::text, 'cast portal'::text::refcursor, pg_typeof(cursor_name)::text, pg_typeof(cursor_history)::text FROM type_matrix_refcursor;

SELECT oid, typname, typtype, typcategory, typlen, typbyval, typalign, typstorage, typarray, typinput::text, typoutput::text, typreceive::text, typsend::text FROM pg_type WHERE oid IN ('refcursor'::regtype, 'refcursor[]'::regtype) ORDER BY oid;
